**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining cards face down to form the draw pile.
• Turn the top card of the draw pile face up to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Players take turns clockwise (unless a direction‑changing card is played). On your turn you may:
1. **Play** one card from your hand that matches the discard pile’s color, number, or symbol.
2. **Draw** one card from the draw pile if you can’t play. If the drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately.
3. **UNO** – When you have only one card left, shout “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Card Types** | • **Number cards** (0–9) – play if same color or number.
• **Skip** – next player loses a turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• **Wild** – change the current color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – change the color and force the next player to draw four cards. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Special Rules** | • **Stacking** – If a +2 or +4 is played, the next player may play another +2/+4 of the same type to pass the penalty onto the following player.
• **Challenge** – If you suspect a +4 was played illegally, you can challenge. If you’re right, the offending player draws 4 cards; if you’re wrong, you draw 6 cards.
• **Color Change** – After playing a Wild or Wild Draw Four, you must announce the new color. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. They receive points equal to the sum of the values of the cards left in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round points to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | --- ### Quick Tips 1. **Keep track of the last color** – helps you decide whether to play a Wild or wait for a match. 2. **Use Draw Two/Draw Four strategically** – stack them when you’re ahead, or use them to block a player who’s close to winning. 3. **Watch for UNO** – always shout “UNO” before the next player starts their turn. Enjoy the game!
